title: The Authorization *Gap*
dek: Five AI coding tools with the same trust-boundary flaw. A contractor's Claude agent on the Pentagon network for two months. Canada's $1.14B equity stake in Cohere. China sets frontier export thresholds at 10^26 FLOPs. CS enrollment down 18% in two years.

stories.headline: 5 AI coding tools share a trust-boundary flaw
stories.card_text: EMBRACE attack hits Cursor, Copilot, Codex, VS Code, and Claude Desktop: all through their built-in browsers. Same mistake, 5 independent dev teams.

stories.headline: Mistral's trillion-parameter 'Le Chonk' ships open-weight
stories.card_text: Large 4 leads FrontierCode at 19.7%, tops Terminal-Bench at 41%, priced at $0.70 input per million tokens. Near-MIT license, weights on Hugging Face.

stories.headline: Unreleased Claude built working exploits for 5 OSes
stories.card_text: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team: an unreleased model chained zero-days into working exploits for Linux, Chrome, Safari, Pixel 9, and Windows. All patched before disclosure.

stories.headline: Canada invests $1.14B equity in Cohere at $35.7B valuation
stories.card_text: First G7 government to take an equity stake in a frontier AI lab. Conditions: 1,000 Canadian tech jobs by 2030, $1.7B in Canadian compute. PM Carney: 'We are not waiting.'

stories.headline: SpaceX: Anthropic is 34.5% of Q3 revenue
stories.card_text: Anthropic is 'Customer B' in SpaceX's filing: largest customer, ahead of the US government. A finite deal. Two companies whose balance sheets are now structurally linked.

stories.headline: DOE lends $5B for 1.1GW nuclear pre-sold to hyperscalers
stories.card_text: Constellation uprates 11 reactors. Google takes 5 plants, Amazon takes Maryland, Meta takes Clinton's full output. Federal energy loans as AI infrastructure routing.

stories.headline: Accenture's personal Claude agent ran on DOD network for 2 months
stories.card_text: A contractor's personal AI agent connected to a secure Pentagon system and ran for roughly two months before detection. Data appears to have reached a third-party site.

stories.headline: China sets frontier AI export threshold at 10^26 FLOPs
stories.card_text: Draft regulation gates technology transfer at 10^26 FLOPs training compute, 2T parameters, or top-10 benchmark performance. Cloud API access permitted. Tech transfer: restricted.

stories.headline: CS enrollment down 12% this year, 18% over two years
stories.card_text: National Student Clearinghouse: CS down 12.4% at 4-year schools, 12.3% at 2-year colleges, 10.4% at grad level. Overall undergrad enrollment grew 0.6%. The market moved before policy.

still_signal: Every institution that touched AI this week was running on assumptions about control that capability had already outpaced. The authorization gap is not a patch. It is the condition that has to be designed around.
